# Context.dev

Context.dev provides web scraping, extraction, brand intelligence, monitoring, and structured web data APIs for AI applications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/context-dev/.

## Actions

- **Extract Structured Web Data** (read-only): Crawl relevant pages from a website and return data matching a caller-provided JSON Schema and extraction instructions.
- **Get Brand** (read-only): Retrieve enriched brand identity, logos, colors, industry, and description using exactly one domain, name, work email, ticker, direct URL,…
- **Get Monitor Limits** (read-only): Return the connected account's plan and current monitor usage versus its monitor limit.
- **Get WebDB Usage** (read-only): Return WebDB credit balance, period consumption, row count, storage, and per-collection usage for an optional time range.
- **Get Website Styleguide** (read-only): Extract a website's colors, typography, spacing, shadows, font assets, and common component styles from either a domain or one direct URL.
- **List Batches** (read-only): List and filter the connected account's asynchronous web batches from newest to oldest, returning one cursor-controlled page.
- **List Monitors** (read-only): List and filter the connected organization's web monitors, returning one cursor-controlled page.
- **List WebDB Collections** (read-only): List the connected account's WebDB collections and return one cursor-controlled page, including each collection's sources, extraction…
- **Parse File** (read-only): Convert an uploaded document, image, source file, or data file into LLM-usable Markdown.
- **Scrape Webpage to Markdown** (read-only): Render one public URL and return its main or CSS-selected content as Markdown.
- **Search Brands** (read-only): Prefix-search Context.dev's existing brand index by company name or domain and return up to 10 lightweight matches.
